name: CitroTech Inc.
summary: CitroTech Inc. operates as a holistic environmental solutions enterprise, delivering a comprehensive array of services. These offerings encompass on-location field operations, the transportation required for remediation projects, and expert guidance in adhering to environmental, health, and safety (EHS) regulations. The firm also extends its expertise to provide specialized technical support directly at client sites, and it manages the on-site and off-site treatment of both hazardous and non-hazardous waste materials. Established on March 14, 1990, the company's main office is situated in Cheyenne, Wyoming.
